text.offer: Quintor says, "I get my ore from the Cragged Mountains, or I did, until the mutant ants moved in. Their jaws go through a miner's boot like it's butter. Kill ten of them and the miners will go back up."
text.progress: Quintor says, "The Cragged Mountains are close by Jasper. The ants keep to the slopes."
text.complete: Quintor says, "Good. The ore carts will be rolling again by morning."

steps.objective: Mutant ants slain in the Cragged Mountains
